author: China Insights
description:
Elon Musk has unveiled a flying car concept—but the story behind it may go back more than two decades, to a bitter Silicon Valley rivalry.
In 2000, Musk was pushed out as CEO of the company that would become PayPal. Peter Thiel, his former rival, took over. Their relationship was marked by fierce competition, a spectacular McLaren crash, and a boardroom power struggle.
But in 2008, when SpaceX was running out of money after three failed rocket launches, Thiel's venture capital firm made a crucial $20 million investment.
Years later, Musk and Thiel found themselves on the same side of major business and political developments. And now, Musk's vision for a flying Tesla Roadster echoes a famous complaint associated with Thiel: the future was supposed to bring flying cars.
Was Musk's flying car inspired by the man who once helped push him out of PayPal?
This is the extraordinary 26-year story of Elon Musk and Peter Thiel—from bitter rivals to unlikely allies.

#ElonMusk #PeterThiel #Tesla
title: Elon Musk and Peter Thiel: 26 Years of Betrayal, Billions and Flying Cars

description:
A $3 million Bugatti. A California real estate agent accused of acting on behalf of China. A mysterious business network with connections to Cambodia's notorious scam industry.
What could these seemingly unrelated stories have in common?
As new court documents and media investigations bring additional details to light, questions are emerging about the relationships surrounding Wanying Zhang, a California real estate agent accused of conducting surveillance connected to Taiwan's president.
The story leads from luxury homes in Southern California to suspected money-laundering operations, Cambodia's Prince Group, and an undercover investigation by Al Jazeera into the country's sprawling scam compounds.
Could criminal money networks also play a role in overseas intelligence operations?
In this episode, we examine the reported connections, the allegations in court documents, and the unanswered questions surrounding this extraordinary case.
